protocol.hypothesis: Raw and normal-reference M6 branches contain complementary representations. Test whether independent clinical conditional heads over their concatenated 512D embeddings improve either requested hard cascade. This extends the previous raw-M5 conditional experts with a distinct normal-reference representation.
protocol.architecture: For each seed concatenate frozen raw256D and normal-reference256D embeddings, standardize on corresponding fitting patients only. Train two independent binary heads for each requested order. Four fixed candidates: infection-first/normal-first by linear/64-GELU-dropout. Frozen source networks never receive downstream gradients.
protocol.conditional_tasks: Infection-first: stage1 infectious versus noninfectious+normal; stage2 noninfectious versus normal using only true eligible fit/stop rows. Normal-first: stage1 abnormal versus normal; stage2 infectious versus noninfectious using true abnormal fit/stop rows. Recompute patient-balanced binary-task weights, exclude ineligible stage2 rows.
protocol.stopping_and_routing: Each binary head early-stops on eligible stopping-patient binary macroF1, then logloss. Average scalar gates over three seeds. Both routing thresholds fixed .5; no threshold tuning. Report stage1, true-eligible stage2 and complete hard-route metrics independently. Ranking uses hard-routed macroF1.
protocol.selection: Require hard-routed original patient CV > .8270827413505814 and validation >= .8904827120381046. Freeze highest passing CV candidate, all source and selected binary-model hashes before previously unused patient-partition confirmation against M6, M5 and fixed Gaussian. No automatic external scoring.
protocol.audit: Existing binary task algebra, fitting and serialization verifier retained. Rebuild all 24 frozen source fit/stop/outer embeddings with independent NumPy projection plus plain M5, verify fit-only geometry and source statistics. Rebuild 512D normalization, every conditional mask/weight, selected binary epoch, all 96 stop/outer predictions with independent NumPy linear/GELU algebra and all stage/route metrics; verify code/source hashes before and after fitting.
protocol.external_test_policy: Development indices only; external features set NaN. No external labels/outcomes/predictions or images loaded.
